title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta35

## Explicit LiDAR terrain capability for Map Card

- Add a model capability flag for the proven **i2 LiDAR** family.
- Expose the capability as `frontend.terrain_overlay.supported` in the authenticated Map API and Site/Multi-mower frontend metadata.
- Keep `frontend.terrain_overlay.available` separate: `supported` answers whether the mower family supports the LiDAR terrain feature, while `available` answers whether a usable terrain resource is currently cached and ready.
- Map Card can therefore show LiDAR-specific editor settings only for supported mower models without guessing from the model name.
- Preserve the existing `terrain` / `elevation` availability and authenticated image endpoints.

## Reduced unnecessary terrain traffic

- Do not start the slow terrain refresh loop for mower families that are not known to support the LiDAR terrain package.
- Do not query the vendor type-2 terrain resource endpoint from non-LiDAR mowers.
- Existing cached terrain on a proven LiDAR mower continues to work unchanged.

No Map Card update is required for the backend contract itself, but a matching Map Card beta can use `frontend.terrain_overlay.supported` as the editor visibility condition.
